flowElements.questionText: Were you in the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024, or did you receive military retirement pay?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome">
  <question>Were you in the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024, or did you receive military retirement pay?</question>
  <input type="boolean">
    <option value="true">Yes</option>
    <option value="false">No</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Were you on extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay">
  <question>Were you on extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024?</question>
  <input type="boolean">
    <option value="true">Yes</option>
    <option value="false">No</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

<fg-set path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay">
  <question>Military basic pay received in 2024</question>
  <hint>Up to $30,000 counts. All of it is subtracted up to $15,000; above that the subtraction shrinks by $1 for each $1 of pay, and at $30,000 nothing is subtracted.</hint>
  <input type="dollar"/>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Did you receive military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024?
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaHasMilitaryRetirement">
  <question>Did you receive military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024?</question>
  <input type="boolean">
    <option value="true">Yes</option>
    <option value="false">No</option>
  </input>
</fg-set>

flowElements.questionText: Taxable military retirement and survivor benefits received in 2024
flowElements.rawXml:
<fg-set path="/vaMilitaryRetirementIncome">
  <question>Taxable military retirement and survivor benefits received in 2024</question>
  <hint>Up to $30,000 counts, and no more than the taxable amount on your 1099-Rs.</hint>
  <input type="dollar"/>
</fg-set>

Line 4, age deduction:

A filer born on or before January 1, 1939 subtracts $12,000; a filer 65 or older born later subtracts $12,000 less $1 for each $1 of adjusted federal AGI over the threshold for the filing status (§ 58.1-322.03(5)). Your share: . Your spouse's share: .

Line 4 shows $0 because the return claims a low-income credit instead, which the law does not allow alongside the age deduction. See Line 23.

Line 7, Schedule ADJ subtractions:

Three subtractions added up: unemployment benefits (code 37, the 1099-G total less anything repaid), military basic pay (code 38, all of it up to $15,000, shrinking to nothing at $30,000) and military benefits (code 60, up to $30,000 and no more than the taxable amount on your 1099-Rs).

The basic pay subtraction shows $0 because the return claims a low-income credit instead. See Line 23.

facts.description: Box 2a of form 1099-R: Taxable Amount (rounded)
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount">
  <Description>Box 2a of form 1099-R: Taxable Amount (rounded)</Description>
  <Export mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency path="../writableTaxableAmount"/>
            </IsComplete>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dependency path="../writableTaxableAmount"/>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Wages, salaries, tips, etc.
facts.description: Wage income to report on line 1a of Form 1040.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/wages">

facts.name: Taxable Social security benefits
facts.description: Taxable Social security benefits to report on line 6b of Form 1040. This is also line 18 of the Social Security Benefits Worksheet. We use the SSBW from instructions for 1040. There is a similar worksheet in Pub 915 where the line numbers are different and will confuse you.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/taxableSocialSecurityBenefits">
  <Name>Taxable Social security benefits</Name>
  <Description>Taxable Social security benefits to report on line 6b of Form 1040. This is also line 18 of the
        Social Security Benefits Worksheet. We use the SSBW from instructions for 1040. There is a similar worksheet in
        Pub 915 where the line numbers are different and will confuse you.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Switch>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <LessThan>
              <Left>
                <Dependency path="/socialSecurityBenefits"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dollar>0</Dollar>
              </Right>
            </LessThan>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
          </Then>
        </Case>
        <Case>
          <When>
            <True/>
          </When>
          <Then>
            <LesserOf>
              <Dependency path="/socialSecurityBenefitsWkshtLine16"/>
              <Multiply>
                <Dependency path="/socialSecurityBenefits"/>
                <Dollar>0.85</Dollar>
              </Multiply>
            </LesserOf>
          </Then>
        </Case>
      </Switch>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Adjusted Gross Income
facts.description: Total income to report on line 11 of Form 1040.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/agi">
  <Name>Adjusted Gross Income</Name>
  <Description>Total income to report on line 11 of Form 1040.</Description>
  <Export downstreamFacts="true" mef="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="income" path="/totalIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/adjustmentsToIncome"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Amount
facts.description: The amount of unemployment compensation.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/form1099Gs/*/amount">
  <Name>Amount</Name>
  <Description>The amount of unemployment compensation.</Description>
  <Export stateSystems="true"/>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Writable Amount Paid Back For Benefits In Tax Year
facts.description: The amount of money paid back in the tax year for the benefits received in the tax year. Takes a written value, but defaults to zero if it hasn't been written. We have to use a default like this, instead of a placeholder, make sure that the user's amount paid back is complete.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear">
  <Name>Writable Amount Paid Back For Benefits In Tax Year</Name>
  <Description>The amount of money paid back in the tax year for the benefits received in the tax year. Takes a
        written value, but defaults to zero if it hasn't been written. We have to use a default like this, instead of a
        placeholder, make sure that the user's amount paid back is complete.</Description>
  <Export stateSystems="true"/>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <IsComplete>
            <Dependency path="../writableAmountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear"/>
          </IsComplete>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="../writableAmountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear"/>
            <Dependency path="../amount"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia age deduction, maximum
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 for each qualifying person. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 4.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum">
  <Name>Virginia age deduction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 for each qualifying person. 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Line 4.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>

  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia age deduction, last birth date for the full amount
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): born on or before January 1, 1939, the full $12,000 regardless of income. A statutory date, kept with the figures so the file holds no date literal outside this block.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionFullAmountBirthDateCutoff">
  <Name>Virginia age deduction, last birth date for the full amount</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): born on or before January 1, 1939, the full
        $12,000 regardless of income. A statutory date, kept with the figures so the file holds
        no date literal outside this block.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>

</Fact>

facts.name: Virginia age deduction income threshold, single
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): the $12,000 is reduced $1 for each $1 of adjusted federal adjusted gross income over $50,000 for single taxpayers.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThresholdSingle">

  <Derived>

  </Derived>
</Fact>

  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-321(A): $23,900 for an individual and spouse (one-half for

  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction, maximum
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): up to $15,000 of military basic pay, reduced $1 for
        each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. 2024 Form 760
        instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 38.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>15000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military benefits subtraction, maximum
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): $30,000 of military benefits for taxable year 2024 ($40,000 from 2025), at any age; (18)(d) defines them as military retirement income, § 134 qualified military benefits, and Survivor Benefit Plan and other military benefits paid to a surviving spouse. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 60.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsMaximum">
  <Name>Military benefits subtraction, maximum</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): $30,000 of military benefits for taxable year 2024
        ($40,000 from 2025), at any age; (18)(d) defines them as military retirement income, § 134
        qualified military benefits, and Survivor Benefit Plan and other military benefits paid to a
        surviving spouse. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 60.</Description>
  <TaxYear>2024</TaxYear>
  <Derived>
    <Dollar>30000</Dollar>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaQualifiesForCreditForLowIncomeIndividuals">
  <Name>Family VAGI at or under the poverty guideline</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(B)(1). Family VAGI (Schedule ADJ Line 10) is the return's
        Virginia AGI with no age deduction or basic pay subtraction; a dependent's own income is not
        on the federal return, so it is taken as $0 here.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaCanClaimLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <LessThanOrEqual>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency path="/vaPovertyGuideline"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThanOrEqual>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: The return claims a low-income credit
facts.description: The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so this is the whole comparison.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit">
  <Name>The return claims a low-income credit</Name>
  <Description>The election Form 760 leaves to the filer: the instructions for Line 4 say to
        "claim the deduction or subtraction that gives you the greatest tax benefit." The return
        claims a credit when there is one and the tax less the credit is lower than the tax keeping
        everything Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D) says the filer, the spouse or both would give up: the age
        deduction of either spouse, the 65 or older and blind exemptions of either spouse, and the
        military basic pay subtraction. Withholding, payments and use tax are the same either way, so
        this is the whole comparison.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaBestLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
      <LessThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTaxAfterCredit"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dependency module="virginiaTax" path="/vaWithoutCreditTax"/>
        </Right>
      </LessThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Claiming the credit gave up the age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was
        worth; on a joint return the figure includes the spouse's deduction.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
      <GreaterThan>
        <Left>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Claiming the credit gave up the military basic pay subtraction
facts.description: Shown on the summary, so the filer sees what the credit replaced and what it was worth.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaCreditReplacedMilitaryBasicPay">

  <Derived>

        <Left>

        </Left>
        <Right>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Right>
      </GreaterThan>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions
facts.description: Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTaxableIncome">
  <Name>Line 15 if the return keeps the age deduction and exemptions</Name>
  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithoutCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>

        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 15 if the return claims a low-income credit

<Fact path="/vaWithCreditTaxableIncome">

  <Description>Line 9 minus Line 14, not below zero.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaIncome" path="/vaWithCreditAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/vaWithCreditTotalDeductions"/>

facts.name: Virginia Filing Status 2, married filing jointly
facts.description: Form 760 Filing Status 2 corresponds to a federal joint return. Federal single and head of household file as Filing Status 1; married filing separately as Status 3. Qualifying surviving spouse is out of scope and treated as Status 1 here.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaIsFilingStatus2">
  <Name>Virginia Filing Status 2, married filing jointly</Name>
  <Description>Form 760 Filing Status 2 corresponds to a federal joint return. Federal single
        and head of household file as Filing Status 1; married filing separately as Status 3.
        Qualifying surviving spouse is out of scope and treated as Status 1 here.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Equal>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filingStatus" path="/filingStatus"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Enum optionsPath="/filingStatusOptions">marriedFilingJointly</Enum>
      </Right>
    </Equal>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse 65 or older
facts.description: On a joint return, the spouse's federal /age65OrOlder (65 on or before January 1, 2025, the rule Virginia's Section B uses). False on any other filing status. A joint return always carries the spouse's date of birth, so the completeness guard only keeps a return with no spouse facts from going incomplete.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder">
  <Name>Spouse 65 or older</Name>
  <Description>On a joint return, the spouse's federal /age65OrOlder (65 on or before January 1,
        2025, the rule Virginia's Section B uses). False on any other filing status. A joint return
        always carries the spouse's date of birth, so the completeness guard only keeps a return with
        no spouse facts from going incomplete.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/age65OrOlder"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/age65OrOlder"/>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <False/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse born on or before January 1, 1939
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a), for the spouse on a joint return: the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of income. Reads the spouse's exported date of birth.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939">
  <Name>Spouse born on or before January 1, 1939</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a), for the spouse on a joint return: the full $12,000 age
        deduction regardless of income. Reads the spouse's exported date of birth.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <All>
            <IsComplete>
              <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/dateOfBirth"/>
            </IsComplete>
            <LessThanOrEqual>
              <Left>
                <Dependency module="filers" path="/vaSpouse/dateOfBirth"/>
              </Left>
              <Right>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionFullAmountBirthDateCutoff"/>
              </Right>
            </LessThanOrEqual>
          </All>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <False/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 1, federal adjusted gross income
facts.description: Read from the federal return (/agi, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 11). Line 2 (additions) is out of scope, so Line 3 equals Line 1.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 1, federal adjusted gross income</Name>
  <Description>Read from the federal return (/agi, exported to MeF as Form 1040 line 11).
        Line 2 (additions) is out of scope, so Line 3 equals Line 1.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Dependency module="taxCalculations" path="/agi"/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 5, taxable Social Security benefits
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(3): benefits under Title II of the Social Security Act included in federal AGI are subtracted. Read from the federal return (Form 1040 line 6b).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 5, taxable Social Security benefits</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(3): benefits under Title II of the Social Security Act
        included in federal AGI are subtracted. Read from the federal return (Form 1040 line
        6b).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Dependency module="socialSecurity" path="/taxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Adjusted federal adjusted gross income (AFAGI)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): federal AGI minus Social Security Title II benefits and other benefits taxable solely under IRC § 86. Used only for the age deduction's income test; on a joint return it is the joint figure. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet lines 2 to 8 (the conformity addition and subtraction on worksheet lines 3 and 5 are out of scope).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAdjustedFederalAdjustedGrossIncome">
  <Name>Adjusted federal adjusted gross income (AFAGI)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): federal AGI minus Social Security Title II benefits
        and other benefits taxable solely under IRC § 86. Used only for the age deduction's
        income test; on a joint return it is the joint figure. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age
        Deduction Worksheet lines 2 to 8 (the conformity addition and subtraction on worksheet
        lines 3 and 5 are out of scope).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Subtract>
      <Minuend>
        <Dependency path="/vaFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
      </Minuend>
      <Subtrahends>
        <Dependency path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
      </Subtrahends>
    </Subtract>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer born on or before January 1, 1939
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of income. Reads the filer's date of birth, which the federal return exports to states.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939">
  <Name>Primary filer born on or before January 1, 1939</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(a): the full $12,000 age deduction regardless of
        income. Reads the filer's date of birth, which the federal return exports to
        states.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <LessThanOrEqual>
      <Left>
        <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/dateOfBirth"/>
      </Left>
      <Right>
        <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionFullAmountBirthDateCutoff"/>
      </Right>
    </LessThanOrEqual>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Primary filer qualifies for the income-based age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older. The federal /age65OrOlder uses the same rule as Virginia's instructions (65 on or before January 1 of the following year), so for tax year 2024 it means born on or before January 1, 1960.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Primary filer qualifies for the income-based age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older. The
        federal /age65OrOlder uses the same rule as Virginia's instructions (65 on or before
        January 1 of the following year), so for tax year 2024 it means born on or before
        January 1, 1960.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency module="filers" path="/primaryFiler/age65OrOlder"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Spouse qualifies for the income-based age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b), for the spouse on a joint return: born after January 1, 1939, and 65 or older.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Spouse qualifies for the income-based age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b), for the spouse on a joint return: born after
        January 1, 1939, and 65 or older.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <All>
      <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseAge65OrOlder"/>
      <Not>
        <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
      </Not>
    </All>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction income threshold for this return
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThreshold">
  <Name>Age deduction income threshold for this return</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $50,000 single, $75,000 married.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaIsFilingStatus2"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThresholdMarried"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThresholdSingle"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction reduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $1 for each $1 of AFAGI over the threshold, never below zero. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet line 11. One figure for the return; on a joint return it applies to each spouse's $12,000.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction">
  <Name>Age deduction reduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5)(b): $1 for each $1 of AFAGI over the threshold, never
        below zero. 2024 Form 760 instructions, Age Deduction Worksheet line 11. One figure for the
        return; on a joint return it applies to each spouse's $12,000.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency path="/vaAdjustedFederalAdjustedGrossIncome"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionIncomeThreshold"/>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the primary filer qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the income-based reduction, never below zero; otherwise $0. The disability subtraction that can be taken instead is out of scope.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaPrimaryFilerAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the primary filer qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939;
        otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the income-based reduction, never below zero;
        otherwise $0. The disability subtraction that can be taken instead is out of scope.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the spouse qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5), for the spouse on a joint return, with the same rule as the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older, $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead reduces the couple's combined $24,000 once, this is the fact to change.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSpouseAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the spouse qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5), for the spouse on a joint return, with the same rule as
        the primary filer: $12,000 if born on or before January 1, 1939; otherwise, if 65 or older,
        $12,000 reduced by the return's income-based reduction; otherwise $0. Assumption, from the
        Code's text: the deduction is "for individuals", and on a joint return "the taxpayer's
        adjusted federal adjusted gross income" is the joint AFAGI, so each spouse's $12,000 is
        reduced by the same excess over $75,000. If Virginia Tax's Age Deduction Worksheet instead
        reduces the couple's combined $24,000 once, this is the fact to change.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaFiler" path="/vaSpouseBornOnOrBefore1939"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaSpouseQualifiesForIncomeBasedAgeDeduction"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <GreaterOf>
            <Dollar>0</Dollar>
            <Subtract>
              <Minuend>
                <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaAgeDeductionMaximum"/>
              </Minuend>
              <Subtrahends>
                <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionReduction"/>
              </Subtrahends>
            </Subtract>
          </GreaterOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Age deduction the return qualifies for
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): the primary filer's deduction plus, on a joint return, the spouse's. Line 4 claims this unless the return claims a low-income credit instead (/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 4 and the Age Deduction Worksheet.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed">
  <Name>Age deduction the return qualifies for</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.03(5): the primary filer's deduction plus, on a joint return,
        the spouse's. Line 4 claims this unless the return claims a low-income credit instead
        (/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit). 2024 Form 760 instructions, Line 4 and the Age Deduction
        Worksheet.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaPrimaryFilerAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaSpouseAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 4, age deduction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those credits instead.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaAgeDeduction">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 4, age deduction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(5): a return on which the filer or the spouse claims the age
        deduction cannot claim the Credit for Low-Income Individuals or either Virginia Earned Income
        Credit. The age deduction the return qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims one of those
        credits instead.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaAgeDeductionAllowed"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Served in, or received retirement pay from, the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024
facts.description: Asked, as the gate to the two military questions. Neither basic pay nor military retirement is identifiable on the forms the federal return exports: a W-2 from the military reports box 1, not basic pay, and the federal 1099-R question "is this from a military retirement plan" is not exported to states.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome">
  <Name>Served in, or received retirement pay from, the U.S. Armed Forces in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Asked, as the gate to the two military questions. Neither basic pay nor military
        retirement is identifiable on the forms the federal return exports: a W-2 from the military
        reports box 1, not basic pay, and the federal 1099-R question "is this from a military
        retirement plan" is not exported to states.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: On extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15). Asked; primary filer only.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay">
  <Name>On extended active duty for more than 90 consecutive days in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15). Asked; primary filer only.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay received in 2024
facts.description: Basic pay only, from the filer's Leave and Earnings Statements; not allowances, bonuses or special pays, which W-2 box 1 also includes.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay">
  <Name>Military basic pay received in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Basic pay only, from the filer's Leave and Earnings Statements; not allowances,
        bonuses or special pays, which W-2 box 1 also includes.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000 reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer, /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction the filer qualifies for (Schedule ADJ code 38)</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): all basic pay up to $15,000; above that, $15,000
        reduced dollar for dollar by the pay over $15,000, so nothing at $30,000 or more. Limited to
        what federal AGI includes, here W-2 wages. The cap is the household's /wages (exported to
        MeF): the federal per-filer figures (/primaryFilerWages, /formW2s/*/filer,
        /formW2s/*/belongsToPrimaryFiler) are not exported to states, so the primary filer's own
        wages cannot be read here; on a joint return the cap is therefore loose by the spouse's
        wages. Claimed on Line 7 only if the return does not claim a low-income credit (Va. Code
        § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryBasicPay"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <LessThanOrEqual>
            <Left>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Left>
            <Right>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Right>
          </LessThanOrEqual>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency module="formW2s" path="/wages"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military basic pay subtraction after the phase-out
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): $15,000 reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over $15,000, never below zero. Only read when the basic pay is over $15,000.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayPhasedOut">
  <Name>Military basic pay subtraction after the phase-out</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(15): $15,000 reduced $1 for each $1 of basic pay over
        $15,000, never below zero. Only read when the basic pay is over $15,000.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <GreaterOf>
      <Dollar>0</Dollar>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <Subtract>
            <Minuend>
              <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPay"/>
            </Minuend>
            <Subtrahends>
              <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBasicPayMaximum"/>
            </Subtrahends>
          </Subtract>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </GreaterOf>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 38, military basic pay subtraction, as claimed
facts.description: The subtraction the filer qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims a low-income credit instead (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 38, military basic pay subtraction, as claimed</Name>
  <Description>The subtraction the filer qualifies for, or $0 when the return claims a low-income
        credit instead (Va. Code § 58.1-339.8(D)(2)).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency module="virginiaCredits" path="/vaClaimsLowIncomeCredit"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtractionAllowed"/>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Received military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c) and (d). Asked; primary filer only.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaHasMilitaryRetirement">
  <Name>Received military retirement pay or Survivor Benefit Plan payments in 2024</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c) and (d). Asked; primary filer only.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Boolean/>
  </Writable>
</Fact>

facts.name: Military benefits received in 2024
facts.description: The taxable amount (1099-R box 2a) of military retirement pay, Survivor Benefit Plan payments and other military benefits paid to a surviving spouse.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryRetirementIncome">
  <Name>Military benefits received in 2024</Name>
  <Description>The taxable amount (1099-R box 2a) of military retirement pay, Survivor Benefit
        Plan payments and other military benefits paid to a surviving spouse.</Description>
  <Writable>
    <Dollar/>
  </Writable>
  <Placeholder>
    <Dollar>0</Dollar>
  </Placeholder>
</Fact>

facts.name: Taxable amount on every 1099-R of the return
facts.description: The sum of box 2a across the 1099-Rs on the federal return (/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount, exported to MeF in each 1099-R). Military benefits are retirement income, so a military benefits subtraction cannot exceed this.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaForm1099RTaxableAmounts">
  <Name>Taxable amount on every 1099-R of the return</Name>
  <Description>The sum of box 2a across the 1099-Rs on the federal return
        (/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount, exported to MeF in each 1099-R). Military benefits are
        retirement income, so a military benefits subtraction cannot exceed this.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <CollectionSum>
      <Dependency module="form1099Rs" path="/form1099Rs/*/taxableAmount"/>
    </CollectionSum>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 60, military benefits subtraction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): up to $30,000 for taxable year 2024, at any age, and never more than the taxable 1099-R income the federal return reports (the subtraction is of an amount "included therein", in federal AGI). It does not bar the low-income credits (§ 58.1-339.8(D) does not list it).
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 60, military benefits subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(18)(c): up to $30,000 for taxable year 2024, at any age, and
        never more than the taxable 1099-R income the federal return reports (the subtraction is of an
        amount "included therein", in federal AGI). It does not bar the low-income credits
        (§ 58.1-339.8(D) does not list it).</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Switch>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Not>
            <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryIncome"/>
          </Not>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <Dependency path="/vaHasMilitaryRetirement"/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <LesserOf>
            <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryRetirementIncome"/>
            <Dependency module="virginiaConstants" path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsMaximum"/>
            <Dependency path="/vaForm1099RTaxableAmounts"/>
          </LesserOf>
        </Then>
      </Case>
      <Case>
        <When>
          <True/>
        </When>
        <Then>
          <Dollar>0</Dollar>
        </Then>
      </Case>
    </Switch>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Schedule ADJ code 37, unemployment benefits subtraction
facts.description: Va. Code § 58.1-322.02: unemployment compensation included in federal AGI is subtracted in full (2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 37). Direct File puts each 1099-G's box 1 into AGI net of what was repaid in the year, and exports both figures to states (/form1099Gs/*/amount, /form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear), so the subtraction is their difference, rounded the way the federal /unemploymentCompensation is. No question is asked.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction">
  <Name>Schedule ADJ code 37, unemployment benefits subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Va. Code § 58.1-322.02: unemployment compensation included in federal AGI is
        subtracted in full (2024 Form 760 instructions, Schedule ADJ subtraction code 37). Direct File
        puts each 1099-G's box 1 into AGI net of what was repaid in the year, and exports both figures
        to states (/form1099Gs/*/amount, /form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear), so the
        subtraction is their difference, rounded the way the federal /unemploymentCompensation is. No
        question is asked.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Round>
      <Subtract>
        <Minuend>
          <CollectionSum>
            <Dependency module="unemployment" path="/form1099Gs/*/amount"/>
          </CollectionSum>
        </Minuend>
        <Subtrahends>
          <CollectionSum>
            <Dependency module="unemployment" path="/form1099Gs/*/amountPaidBackForBenefitsInTaxYear"/>
          </CollectionSum>
        </Subtrahends>
      </Subtract>
    </Round>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Form 760 Line 7, subtractions from Schedule ADJ
facts.description: Schedule ADJ Line 7: unemployment benefits (code 37), military basic pay (code 38) as claimed, and military benefits (code 60). The other Schedule ADJ subtractions are out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaScheduleAdjSubtractions">
  <Name>Form 760 Line 7, subtractions from Schedule ADJ</Name>
  <Description>Schedule ADJ Line 7: unemployment benefits (code 37), military basic pay (code 38)
        as claimed, and military benefits (code 60). The other Schedule ADJ subtractions are out of
        scope and taken as $0.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBasicPaySubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Subtractions the low-income credits do not affect
facts.description: Line 5 (Social Security), and on Line 7 the unemployment and military benefits subtractions. The age deduction and the military basic pay subtraction are the two that a low-income credit replaces.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaSubtractionsEitherWay">
  <Name>Subtractions the low-income credits do not affect</Name>
  <Description>Line 5 (Social Security), and on Line 7 the unemployment and military benefits
        subtractions. The age deduction and the military basic pay subtraction are the two that a
        low-income credit replaces.</Description>
  <Derived>
    <Add>
      <Dependency path="/vaTaxableSocialSecurityBenefits"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaUnemploymentCompensationSubtraction"/>
      <Dependency path="/vaMilitaryBenefitsSubtraction"/>
    </Add>
  </Derived>
</Fact>

facts.name: Line 8 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction
facts.description: Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them. Line 6 (state income tax refund, Va. Code § 58.1-322.02(5)) is out of scope and taken as $0.
facts.rawXml:
<Fact path="/vaWithoutCreditTotalSubtractions">
  <Name>Line 8 if the return keeps the age deduction and military basic pay subtraction</Name>
  <Description>Lines 4 + 5 + 6 + 7 with Line 4 and code 38 as the filers qualify for them. Line 6
